test_design.application: new electrode application, same participant and nominal placement
test_design.baseline: collect a fresh relaxed baseline in each posture before any gestures
test_design.zero_shot: score frozen models on fixed test repetitions before fitting or tuning
test_design.adaptation_curve: fit using nested calibration repetitions 1, then 1-2, then 1-3; always score the same fixed test repetitions 4-6
test_design.primary_metric: trial grouped smoothed macro F1 across seven gestures
secondary_metrics: false active fraction on independent rest
test_design.posture_truth: operator supplied block order; keep camera orientation as an audit measurement
test_design.no_test_feedback: do not change model, threshold, trial exclusion or preprocessing after inspecting fixed test scores

normalization_comparison: strict zero shot uses frozen original baseline scale
baseline adaptation uses only fresh rest baseline and keeps model weights frozen
electrode_check: confirm transmitter battery and receiver stream
collect a short rest and fist pilot; flag flat or saturated channels
record placement photo or written landmarks and reapplication ID
